artworks.title: L'Agent d'affaires
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in formal attire approaching a door labeled "Justice de Paix." The drawing depicts a figure wearing a high top hat, a dark coat tails, white cravat, and striped trousers, holding some papers while walking towards a door with the words "Justice de Paix" written on it. The figure's posture and expression convey a sense of urgency or determination. The scene is set within an interior space, suggested by the visible staircase and corridor in the background. The illustration employs sharp lines and shading to provide depth and dimension to the scene.

artworks.title: Le Ravageur
artworks.description: This image depicts two individuals on a street in the rain. The person on the right is in a crouched position with their body bent over, reaching down to the ground. This person is seen from the side and wears a black cap, a light-colored shirt with the sleeves rolled up, and dark pants that appear to be rolled up past the knees. They are barefoot and holding a basket. The person on the left is holding a large umbrella over their head. They are seen from the side, partially turned away, dressed in a long, dark gown and bonnet. The background shows a street scene with tall buildings visible amidst diagonal rain lines. The ground appears wet and reflective.

artworks.title: Le Maraudeur
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slight forward lean. The person has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and an open mouth. They are wearing a tall, dark hat and an overcoat with pants. The person is pointing upwards with one hand and holding a string behind their back. Nearby, there is a cat perched on a ledge on the left and a sleeping dog on the ground. The background features a textured surface resembling a wall.

artworks.title: Le Ramasseur de bouts de cigares
artworks.description: The image shows a man in motion, leaning forward with both hands raised near his chest. He wears a tall top hat and tattered clothing. Two figures beside him wear similar attire, with one holding a cigar. The background includes trees and a cobblestone ground.

artworks.title: Le Marchand d'habits
artworks.description: The image displays a man walking on a cobblestone street. The man is in profile, looking to the right, carrying various items. He has distinct facial features, such as a nose and facial hair, potentially a beard or mustache. He wears a tall hat with hair flowing from underneath, layered clothing including a long coat or cloak, a scarf, and holds an umbrella and a possible guitar while additional garments are under his arm. The background features a faint horse outline and a second sketchy figure, implying a busy street scene in an urban setting near a building or alley.

artworks.title: Le Tondeur de chiens
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals on a cobblestone street. One person, a man, is seated and grooming a dog in his lap. The man has short, slicked-back hair and wears a short-sleeved shirt, a vest, and loose pants. An elderly woman stands nearby, wearing a shawl and a bonnet, looking concerned. She is clasping her hands together. In the background are buildings and a sign post near the seated man. The sky is shaded.

artworks.title: L'Acteur des Funambules
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking in a snowy street scene. The man is eating as he walks briskly in a snow-covered area. He is wearing checkered attire, a long coat, and a tall top hat. Snowflakes are falling around him. The man appears joyful and content as he eats from a small packet. Onlookers are behind a rail, observing him. A sign to the right reads "ENTRÉE DES ACTEURS." The actor is approaching a door. The drawing captures a moment of simplicity and delight in the actor's routine against a wintry backdrop.

artworks.title: 7 heures du matin
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting up in bed with a cat and a dog beside him. He is smiling and wearing a bedcap and a nightshirt. There is a candle on a nightstand, clothes on a chair, slippers on the floor, and a patterned curtain next to the bed.

artworks.title: Une heure - Promenade au Luxembourg
artworks.description: The image depicts a man holding an open umbrella, wearing a top hat, long coat, vest, and trousers. His features are exaggerated, with a long nose and prominent chin. He is walking a small dog on a leash in a park setting with trees and water. In the background, a person is partially submerged in the water, looking up, and a group of people, including another man in a top hat, can be seen to the left. The illustration is filled with detailed line work, creating a whimsical and dynamic atmosphere.

artworks.title: 2 heures - Le gouter d'Azor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interaction outside a shop. Two individuals are standing on a stone path, with one holding a cane and the other holding a circular object in their hand, possibly food, while a small dog stands nearby on its hind legs, reaching towards the item. In the background, there is a window display with what appears to be baked goods and a hanging poultry item. The style of the drawing is detailed with shading and expressive character features. The setting gives the impression of a comical everyday scene from the 19th century.

artworks.title: 9 heures du soir
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man lying in bed holding a candlestick and appearing to snuff out a candle. He is propped up against a pillow, wearing a nightcap and a nightshirt. The bed is adorned with a floral quilt and pillows, with cats resting nearby. In the background, heavy curtains hang around the bed, and there is a glass and a small bottle on a bedside table.

artworks.title: Ménage modèle...
artworks.description: The image features two individuals standing behind a window sill filled with potted plants. One person is pouring water onto a plant from a watering can, while the other is observing the plants. The scene is framed by a dark arched window opening with detailed foliage surrounding the figures, creating an intimate indoor garden setting. The background is mostly dark, accentuating the foreground elements.

artworks.title: Je suis logé un peu haut... mais... je jouis d'une jolie vue!
artworks.description: Two individuals are standing closely together on a balcony. The person on the left is wearing a patterned robe and a cap with a brim, with relaxed facial features and a slight smile. The person on the right wears a dark coat and has short, curly hair, looking towards the other person. The background shows a cityscape of rooftops, chimneys, and a slightly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Une Idylle dans les blés
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated in an outdoor setting with tall grass or grains surrounding them. The woman on the left is wearing a dress and has her hair in a bun, while the man on the right is dressed in a plaid outfit and wears a hat. The man is holding a small object, and a top hat is placed beside him on the ground. The background features rolling hills and a few trees.

artworks.title: Quand il y a trente degrés de chaleur...
artworks.description: The image shows two people outdoors. The man is lying down on his back, and the woman is seated next to him. They are in a wooded area surrounded by trees and natural foliage.

artworks.title: Un Veritable amateur
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals observing artwork in a gallery. The drawing depicts a scene with two figures standing in a gallery room surrounded by framed artworks hanging on the walls. The more prominent figure is holding a magnifying glass and is leaning closely towards the artwork to inspect it carefully. The second figure stands to the left, with arms crossed and looks at the artworks from a distance. The pieces on the walls appear to include portraits and landscapes. The style of the drawing, with its clear lines and use of shading, suggests a satirical or humorous observation.

artworks.title: Six degrés au-dessous de zéro...
artworks.description: The image shows two people from head to toe. The person on the left is leaning forward, looking out of a window and holding the curtain aside with both hands. This person has a receding hairline with short, slightly messy hair, wearing a long-sleeved, loose-fitting shirt and tight pants. On the right, another person stands slightly hunched, with hands clasped in front of their chest. This individual has shoulder-length hair, wearing a long dress with sleeves. Both individuals are barefoot. The background features a heavily shaded room with a window on the left side, partially covered by dark curtains. The window allows light to cast upon the floor, creating contrast against the shaded interior.

artworks.title: Ce que le bourgeois est convenu de nommer une... distraction
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two chairs, a hat, and newspapers among trees. The artwork shows two chairs, with hat and newspapers prominently placed, situated in an outdoor setting amongst trees. The style of the drawing, marked with distinct lines and shading, captures a moment of leisure or perhaps a depiction of everyday life. The trees are tall with full canopies, providing a textured and layered backdrop, while the vacant chairs suggest an implied presence. The focus on the chairs, hat, and newspapers highlights the objects more than any potential activity.

artworks.title: Quand le journal est trop intéressant
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals interacting with a newspaper. In the image, two individuals are reading a newspaper while a third individual is seated. The two individuals reading are standing close to each other with a concentrated posture over the newspaper. The individual seated in an ornately carved chair is leaning back with closed eyes and an open mouth.

artworks.title: Il admire les beautés de la nature - Plaine St. Denis
artworks.description: The image is a full-body illustration of a couple standing side by side. The man is standing upright, facing forward with his right arm linked with the woman. He has a prominent facial profile with a large nose and chin and is wearing a tall top hat. His hair appears to be neatly styled. The woman, positioned slightly in front of him and to his left, has her head tilted gently toward him. Her face is obscured by the bonnet she is wearing. She is holding an open parasol. The man's attire consists of a jacket, while the woman is wearing a bonnet and a long dress typical of the 19th century. The woman also has a shawl draped over her shoulders. The background features a desolate-looking landscape with distant rolling hills or plains. The image is styled in an illustrative manner.

artworks.title: Ayant la prétention de faire partie du beau monde
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a social gathering. In the foreground, there is a man and a woman dressed elegantly. They are shown in a poised manner, with slight physical contact. In the background, a group of people is partially visible, engaged in conversation behind a curtain. The setting includes decorative elements like a large vase on a pedestal, suggesting an elegant room. The artist's use of shading and line work highlights the texture of the clothing and gives depth to the figures, conveying a satirical look at bourgeois society.

artworks.title: Un Chateau en Espagne
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing next to each other. The man is wearing a tall top hat, a long coat, and striped pants, with his hands in his pockets. The woman wears a bonnet and a long dark dress, with her arms crossed. The man's face is turned slightly to his right, displaying prominent facial features. The woman's face is turned slightly downward, with a solemn expression, holding a stick in her right hand and drawing on the ground. In the background, there is a tree on the right and small trees or shrubs on the left, alongside elaborate clouds in the sky. The drawing is monochromatic, depicting the figures in a contemplative pose.

artworks.title: Une Soirée au corps de garde
artworks.description: The image shows two men in uniform. One man is seated on a wooden chair, leaning forward with his arms on his thighs. He appears to be asleep or resting his eyes. He has short hair and wears a uniform with epaulettes and a sash. The other man is standing beside him, bent slightly forward with a wide-open mouth. He appears to be yawning. He has short hair visible beneath a small cap and his uniform is similar to the seated man, with epaulettes and a sash. Both uniforms are dark with buttons and a contrasting sash. At their feet, a pile of wood or logs is arranged in front of a stove. The room appears dimly lit, with shading and the stove's dim glow. The background features a dark wall with visible textures.
